name: Tamiyo, Field Researcher
oracle_text:
+1: Choose up to two target creatures. Until your next turn, whenever either of those creatures deals combat damage, you draw a card.
−2: Tap up to two target nonland permanents. They don't untap during their controller's next untap step.
−7: Draw three cards. You get an emblem with "You may cast spells from your hand without paying their mana costs."
blocked_sentences: +1: Choose up to two target creatures. Until your next turn, whenever either of those creatures deals combat damage, you draw a card.

needs.what: a `delayed_trigger` duration "until_your_next_turn" (subscription lasts across turns, repeats on every firing, and ends in the controller's next untap step), plus a `subject` that may name up to two targeted creatures so the trigger fires when EITHER of them deals combat damage (to a player, planeswalker or creature)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: op_delayed_trigger only accepts DELAYED_DURATIONS = this_turn / until_it_fires / once_this_turn, none of which lasts through opponents' turns and repeats; its `subject` resolves the selector and keeps only chosen[0], so a two-creature target set watches just one creature
